title.to: Conversion tracking and consent for anth.us

description.to:
As the owner of anth.us, I want lead and CTA conversions measured in GA4 with a consent banner that matches the privacy policy, so that I can see which pages and solutions produce leads and can later run Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns lawfully for global visitors.

Context (verified 2026-10-19): anth.us loads GA4 G-31SC26SDGX via the Papyrus page template. AnthusAI/Anth.us-web#82 (merged, 50c07d2) added generate_lead (fires only on a confirmed 202 receipt from the engage form; params form_id, lead_source = '<from>#<cta>' or 'direct', optional solution; no PII) and cta_click (cta_text, cta_location, link_url path-only, beacon transport) via web/assets/conversion-events.js, with site-nav.js adding from and cta params to /engage/ links. AnthusAI/Papyrus#366 (PPY-0ac4a9, CI green, not merged or released) adds opt-in Consent Mode v2 with an approved banner. AnthusAI/Anth.us-web#77 (draft) adds the /privacy/ page, which describes the banner as live, so the two must ship together. No paid ads yet; Google Ads and possibly LinkedIn planned later; visitors are global.

Scope: the eight child issues. The Ads and LinkedIn items stay blocked until those campaigns start.
